title: Nuevo Laredo Takes Animal Welfare Lessons Into Schools
excerpt: Nuevo Laredo's municipal government is taking animal welfare talks into schools, teaching children responsible pet ownership and how to prevent mistreatment and abandonment.
content:
The municipal government of Nuevo Laredo is bringing animal welfare and protection lessons into the city's schools, with children learning about responsible pet ownership and how to prevent mistreatment, according to the Oficina de Corresponsales news agency.

Staff from the Secretariat of Social Welfare visited the Jardín de Niños “Profa. Ma. del Carmen Domínguez Zertuche” in the colonia Benito Juárez, where children learned about protecting animals, giving them the care they need and avoiding mistreatment and abandonment, according to the report.

The talks aim to teach new generations about the responsibility of having a pet and to foster respectful coexistence with all living beings, according to the report.

The municipal government will continue visiting more schools across the city, from preschool through elementary school, as part of the effort to build a more conscious and responsible city when it comes to animal welfare, according to the report.

Sources: Oficina de Corresponsales.
